summary: Remove the managed Bitcoin shutdown kill deadline and expose chainstate replay progress
details: Managed node shutdown disables the running Bitcoin container restart policy, requests authenticated RPC stop, and waits for Core to exit before Compose cleanup.

When RPC is unavailable during warmup, shutdown falls back only to SIGTERM and never escalates automatically to SIGKILL; periodic heartbeats report elapsed time and the latest persistent shutdown phase.

While Bitcoin RPC is warming up after an unclean stop, the node dashboard derives bounded read-only ReplayBlocks progress from the current debug.log startup segment without using it for readiness decisions.
